items.title: SPS exhibiting and presenting at the Pharmacy Show, NEC Birmingham, 11 to 12 October 2026
items.summary: The NHS Specialist Pharmacy Service will be on stand A85 at the Pharmacy Show, NEC Birmingham, on 11 and 12 October 2026, with two presentations in the Primary Care Pharmacy Theatre: vaccination and Human Medicines Regulations changes since COVID, on 11 October at 16:45, and tackling polypharmacy…

items.title: Information for nurse prescribers on Levemir discontinuation issued
items.summary: A National Patient Safety Alert has been issued over the discontinuation of the diabetes drug Levemir in December. Stocks of Levemir (insulin detemir) FlexPen pre-filled pens and Penfill cartridges are expected to be exhausted by the end of the year.

items.summary: British Journal of Nursing, Volume 35, Issue 17, Page S4-S9, September 2026.

items.title: Pharmacy First expansion assumes conditions presenting as ‘minor’ can’t be complex, GPs warn
items.summary: GP leaders have criticised the Government’s expansion of Pharmacy First, warning against the assumption that conditions presenting as ‘minor’ are usually suitable to be diagnosed and treated outside of general practice.

items.title: NHS England announces final choice of new Pharmacy First prescribing pathways
items.summary: DHSC and NHS England have formally announced the final five new prescribing clinical pathways for Pharmacy First, including migraine and acne, alongside existing conditions. From autumn 2026, community pharmacists will prescribe for all Pharmacy First conditions.

items.title: GP leaders issue ‘urgent’ patient safety concerns over Levemir discontinuation
items.summary: GP leaders and experts are warning of an ‘increasingly urgent’ need to switch patients with diabetes from Levemir insulin before it is discontinued at the end of this year.
